wrong-return.label: Two adjacent monsters, the dangerous one examined first
wrong-return.explanation: A level-30 Blackguard stands between an adjacent master lich (examined first, scoring 234 with the danger bonus) and an adjacent kobold (examined second, scoring 30). The chooser's real call re-runs the attack to execute it and reports the value; the original returns the last monster's 30, the correction returns the best one's 234.
